originalEntry.title: Motion-designer promo video for mdfor.dev
originalEntry.author: HO_BA
originalEntry.description: A 30-second promo for mdfor.dev built on the showreel prompt, with product screenshots broken into animated components and motion synced to music.
originalEntry.description_zh: 在「动效作品集」提示词上改出的 30 秒 mdfor.dev 宣传片，产品截图拆成组件逐个做动画，动作卡着音乐走。
originalEntry.prompt: Make a dynamic 30-second motion graphics video that shows what an incredible motion designer you are, like it's your showreel for a résumé. go all out.  Make it a video to introduce https://mdfor.dev Use actual product screenshot/logo/assets Must have music and motion must match the music  Do it like a real professional production video, not like a demo or prototype. Add more animation and motion design; avoid using screenshots as raw; instead, break them down into components/icons so we can animate those too. Make the motions more juicy. Use the best motion design techniques you can.
originalEntry.prompt_zh: 做一段 30 秒的动态图形视频，展示你是多么出色的动效设计师，就像简历里的作品集一样。拿出全部本事。把它做成介绍 https://mdfor.dev 的视频。使用真实的产品截图 / logo / 素材。必须有音乐，而且动作要和音乐对上。要做得像真正的专业制作视频，而不是 demo 或原型。加入更多动画和动效设计；不要直接使用原始截图，而是把它们拆成组件 / 图标，这样也能给它们做动画。让动作更有弹性、更带劲。用上你能用的最好的动效设计技巧。
